mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1000 CLIENT_KEY AS [key], REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(19),REQ_DATE,120),'-',''),' ',''),':','') AS request_date, DEPT_CODE AS department_code, PHONE AS phone, CALLBACK_NUMBER AS callback_number, TEMPLATE_CODE, CONCAT(ISNULL(KV_DATA, ''),ISNULL(KV_DATA2, '')) AS kv_data_string, CAMPAIGN_ID, PUSH_USER_ID, FILE_DATA AS file_data_string, KISA_ORIGCODE AS kisa_origin_code, RCS_AGENCY_ID, RCS_AGENCY_KEY, RCS_BRAND_KEY FROM ${tableName} WHERE MSG_STATUS = 'ready' AND TRAFFIC_TYPE = #{lineType} AND REQ_DATE < GETDATE()
